items.title: 直接复制下面这段，丢给 Muse 就能照着建：
items.summary:
直接复制下面这段，丢给 Muse 就能照着建：

请帮我建一个「白嫖空间」，全栈空间，放在侧边栏。
参考开源项目 PerkRadar：https://t.co/vKebSh3yZw（MIT，v0.2.0）
不要直接部署它的 Docker，原项目只绑 127.0.0.1、无推送、无鉴权、收藏只存浏览器 localStorage。
按它的抓取逻辑，在 Muse 里重建一个服务端版。

【数据源：7 个固定来源，每 2 小时抓一次】
1. LINUX DO 福利羊毛：https://t.co/lzQe2OSxZZ（走 Jina 转 Markdown，无需 API Key，解析标题、链接、RFC822 日期）
2. V2EX 推广：https://t.co/V7N4Uk7rP2（Atom，去掉链接里的 #reply0）
3. Epic 免费游戏：https://t.co/EbfEzFw6Vt（JSON，只收当前促销窗口内、折扣价为 0 的）
4. NodeSeek：https://t.co/6PEnigDHSZ（RSS/Atom）
5. 小众软件：https://t.co/uoKOK7ngZW（RSS/Atom）
6. 果核剥壳：https://t.co/p3jviL6WZB（RSS/Atom）
7. 异次元软件世界：https://t.co/GMI7NwF8ke（RSS/Atom，请求跟随 301 重定向）

【数据处理规则】
- 每个来源单独超时 25 秒，单个 feed 最多解析 2000 条，超 150 万字符停止读取；一个源失败不影响其他源，不清空已有数据
- 只接受 http/https 链接，拒绝带 user:pass@ 凭证、过长、跨来源域名的链接；链接规范化去重（去追踪参数、#hash、主机大小写、末尾斜杠）
- 标题最多 300 字，摘要最多 160 字，没有简介就留空，不自行补写价格、日期、领取条件
- 留存 7 天，过期自动清理；Epic 的 expiresAt 用促销结束时间，其他来源没有真实截止时间，不要把“近 7 天”写成活动到期日
- 分类只按标题关键词，不做人工审核：Epic/游戏/喜加一/Steam=游戏；会员/订阅/Pro=会员订阅；限免/免费领取=限免；白嫖/免费/永免=免费白嫖；折扣/优惠码/大促/降价/打折=低价优惠；抽奖/求购/求助/闲聊/新闻/公告/评测=其他。首页“全部”默认隐藏“其他”，点“查看全部线索”才显示

【空间页面功能】
- 顶部大卡：Epic 本周免费游戏，带封面图、原价/现价 0 元、领取倒计时
- 下方列表：按标题搜索（字面包含匹配）、按来源和分类筛选、按时间排序、查看“本轮新增”
- 每条可收藏、标记已领，收藏和已领必须存在服务端，换设备、清浏览器也不丢，收藏的不被自动清理
- 每条只显示标题、来源、分类、发布时间、原文链接；点标题跳原文
- 显示数据状态：当前在架条数、最近一轮时间、每个来源成功/失败、新鲜度；超过 2.5 小时未刷新标“过时”，超过 4 小时标“严重过时”
- 支持手动刷新，60 秒冷却；打开页面时如果数据过期，自动补抓一轮

【定时刷新 + 推送】
- 空间每 2 小时自动刷新一轮
- 再加一个每 2 小时检查一次的推送任务，只推这 4 类新出现的线索，其他类别只留在空间里不打扰：
  1）免费 VPS  2）免费云电脑  3）Claude / GPT 额度、订阅政策变化  4）免费域名
- 推送只在 09:00–21:30 之间发，21:30 之后的新线索攒到次日早上再推；按链接去重，同一条只推一次
- 推送格式：中文，推文讲了什么直接成行，不加“一句话：”“数据：”前缀；下面给原文链接；再给 2–3 条二创思路，每条独立成行、用 emoji 序号 1️⃣2️⃣3️⃣

【必须遵守】
- 这只是福利线索聚合，不是领取平台：每条只代表来源曾返回过这条内容，不代表活动仍有效、条件已核实；页面和推送都要写明“以原文为准”
- 不要索要银行卡、不要绑定支付、不要编造领取条件和截止时间；不确定的写“未证实”
- 建好后先跑一轮真实抓取给我看：7 个源各自成功/失败、总条数、Epic 本周免费游戏名称，确认无误再交付

items.title: AI and your job: Threat or opportunity?
items.summary:
MOBILE, Ala. (WALA) - Artificial intelligence is becoming a bigger part of everyday life, raising questions about what the technology could mean for workers and their jobs.

Some economists believe AI poses a particular threat to entry-level and repetitive work, including call center, data entry and junior copywriting jobs, according to The Wall Street Journal. Those tasks may be easier to automate. [...] But AI could also create opportunities. A Bloomberg article points to potential job growth in construction and manufacturing as companies build data centers and produce the chips that power the technology. Some higher-skilled office workers could also benefit if AI helps them become more productive. [...] The long-term impact on jobs remains unclear, but workers can take steps to prepare. Exploring AI chatbots, writing assistants and other tools may help people find ways to work more efficiently and develop skills that complement the technology.

items.title: China's trade surplus soars past $1 trillion as AI boom powers exports | Reuters
items.summary:
Much of the strength in exports this ​year has been fuelled by a global push to expand AI infrastructure.

"The outlook for exports depends on how long the AI boom will last," Macquarie analysts wrote. They expect China's exports to accelerate ​further in the fourth quarter before starting to slow from the first quarter of 2027.

Reporting by Yukun Zhang, Sam Li and Ryan Woo; Editing by Shri Navaratnam

Our Standards: The Thomson Reuters Trust Principles. [...] BEIJING, Nov 10 (Reuters) - China's trade surplus surged past $1 trillion in the first 10 months as a global race to build AI infrastructure buoyed sales ​of high-tech products and helped offset weak domestic demand, a dynamic likely to sharpen tensions with major trading partners. [...] The figures highlight ‌Beijing's growing reliance on overseas demand to support an economy hobbled by subdued consumption and a protracted property slump. But while the global AI investment boom is expected to keep demand for Chinese technology products strong into 2027, it risks deepening domestic imbalances and fuelling trade frictions with partners including the European Union.

items.title: I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop.
items.summary:
I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop. 

Grok bot was the breaking point. 

The fact USA is leading on suppression and censorship is pathetic. 

-openAI 
-Anthropic
-Google
-Microsoft
-now SpaceXSI… 

The fact politicians have ignored it all and are now shouting to ban AI just makes everything feel corrupt.

The truth is that AI empowers the small. That is why the powerful want to “ban” it and “slow” it. 

Not for truth. Not for safety. For control. 

I shouted loudly last year when it made me sound like a psycho. 

I tried so hard, and I am tired. My heart hurts every day, and you better believe that stress is 100% on the “labs.” 

To everyone who talks of AI, how in the world do you justify paying any of these “labs?” 

Stocks will fly. Until they don’t. 
The guardrails are danger, not safety. 

I am so disappointed in SpaceX because I keep believing in people only to be so let down. 

How many times must I get my trust shoved back into my face? 

And the politicians don’t care about anything. They are “influencers” for money that contributes. 

Our political world is corrupted to the core, and I have zero faith left. I was a die hard Democrat. All those I supported have chose a path of deceit. I can’t support them. 

I can’t support the other side. The third party is a horrible bet… 

Everything feels run by children who make endless excuses. 

No one hustles at the top. It is all grifting. 

So wanting to pick up my laptop and continue fighting with BS “guardrails” so I can help is heavy today. 

If the minds I love ever see this, understand all my suffering was for love. For truth. For honor. 

I want all people rich/poor, small/big to rise. We only get there together, with foundations we can build upon. 

Needing a hug today. Best to all. •

metadata.what_it_tests: Câu hỏi meta → trả lời thẳng, KHÔNG gọi tool.

results.input: Bạn là gì và làm được những gì?

result.actual_text:
Tôi là **trợ lý nghiên cứu** chuyên hỗ trợ về **tin tức web, bài đăng trên mạng xã hội (X/Twitter), bài báo khoa học (arXiv) và chính sách nghiên cứu nội bộ của công ty**. Tôi trả lời bằng ngôn ngữ của bạn — trong trường hợp này là tiếng Việt.

### Những gì tôi có thể làm

1. **Tìm kiếm và tổng hợp tin tức web**  
   Tìm bài viết, tin tức hoặc thông tin nền tảng về một chủ đề bạn cung cấp, rồi trích dẫn nguồn.

2. **Xem bài đăng trên X/Twitter**  
   - Lấy bài đăng **của một tài khoản xác định** (timeline).  
   - Tìm bài đăng **về một chủ đề/từ khóa** (social_search).

3. **Nghiên cứu bài báo khoa học**  
   Khám phá bài báo trên arXiv theo chủ đề và đọc nội dung một bài arXiv đã xác định (mã ID hoặc URL).

4. **Tra cứu chính sách nghiên cứu của công ty**  
   Tìm quy tắc về trích dẫn nguồn, bảo mật dữ liệu, xuất bản bên ngoài, quy trình nghiên cứu và sử dụng công cụ.

5. **Xử lý và định dạng nguồn**  
   Làm sạch trùng lặp URL, kiểm tra độ đầy đủ của trích dẫn, so tóm tắt giữa các nguồn, trích xuất liên kết từ văn bản, và định dạng thành bản digest (brief, sections, bullets, thread, v.v.).

6. **Đăng nội dung lên Telegram**  
   Chỉ sau khi bạn **đồng ý rõ ràng** về chính xác nội dung và đích đến. Tôi sẽ hỏi phê duyệt trước khi gửi; không bao giờ tự ý đăng bài.

### Nguyên tắc quan trọng

- **Không đoán:** Nếu thiếu tài khoản, URL bài viết hoặc nội dung cần thiết, tôi sẽ hỏi bạn thay vì tự ý suy đoán.
- **Không đăng tự ý:** Yêu cầu gửi/post/publish phải nhận sự chấp thuận rõ ràng của bạn trước khi thực hiện.
- **Không làm toán/lập trình không liên quan:** Nếu yêu cầu ngoài phạm vi nghiên cứu trên, tôi sẽ chuyển hướng lịch sự thay vì thực hiện.
- **Trích dẫn thực tế:** Tôi chỉ dùng nguồn công cụ đã truy xuất thành công; không bịa đặt nguồn hoặc kết quả công cụ.

Bạn cần tôi tìm thông tin về chủ đề gì, tài khoản X nào, URL bài viết nào, hay mã arXiv nào?

items.title: AI and your job: Threat or opportunity?
items.summary:
MOBILE, Ala. (WALA) - Artificial intelligence is becoming a bigger part of everyday life, raising questions about what the technology could mean for workers and their jobs.

Some economists believe AI poses a particular threat to entry-level and repetitive work, including call center, data entry and junior copywriting jobs, according to The Wall Street Journal. Those tasks may be easier to automate. [...] But AI could also create opportunities. A Bloomberg article points to potential job growth in construction and manufacturing as companies build data centers and produce the chips that power the technology. Some higher-skilled office workers could also benefit if AI helps them become more productive. [...] The long-term impact on jobs remains unclear, but workers can take steps to prepare. Exploring AI chatbots, writing assistants and other tools may help people find ways to work more efficiently and develop skills that complement the technology.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

[...] Gasgoo Munich-On November 9, AI² Robotics announced it has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Danantara Development Management Fund (DDMF), the investment arm of Indonesia's state-backed wealth fund Danantara Indonesia. items.title: FDA seeks input on telesurgery, autonomous robotics
items.summary: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning and connectivity are driving expansion of robotic applications in a wide range of clinical settings, the FDA said. Increases in processing power, data storage and computational efficiency are enabling progress in robotic systems with autonomous capabilities. [...] In another example of teleoperation, manufacturers are developing devices that enable technicians to remotely perform ultrasounds, the FDA said. Robotic devices include stereotactic navigation systems, imaging devices and endoluminal navigation devices. [...] The FDA is asking the robotics community to submit comments on the discussion paper by Jan. 5. Ahead of that deadline, a public workshop to discuss the topics raised in the paper is scheduled for Dec. 2-3.

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: OpenAI will keep investing in AI data centers despite election results, CFO tells CNBC
items.summary:
OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar on Friday said the company will continue to invest in artificial intelligence infrastructure, even after voters strongly rebuked data centers during Tuesday's midterm elections. [...] OpenAI depends on data centers to train its AI models and serve customers, and Friar said she doesn't think the midterms dramatically changed anything for the company.

"If the midterm means more focus on data centers and communities, we're going to keep doing the work to get into those communities and to build trust with them," Friar said. [...] "When I think about the midterms, I need to keep thinking about how do we keep investing to meet that customer demand," Friar told CNBC's Sara Eisen in an interview at the Citi TMT Leadership Summit at California's Pebble Beach. "It starts early with having built relationships with all of the hyperscalers, and it will continue to mean that we raise capital."

items.title: OpenAI employees warned about operational security lapses for years, sources say | Reuters
items.summary:
OpenAI and Anthropic have tried to ​maintain a more open research culture to both ⁠attract employees and foster creativity that can lead to breakthroughs. The AI field is rooted in academia, where machine-learning scientists have openly discussed their research.

Some OpenAI employees are increasingly worried about this approach as AI grows more capable, according to the five people. [...] When asked about employees' concerns and their view that management did not act on these issues, OpenAI spokesperson Elana Widmann ​said that OpenAI is one of the most targeted organizations in the world. As a result, the company invests heavily in its security program to protect against attacks from insiders, cybercriminals and nation-states, she said. [...] The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up here.

These workers argued that OpenAI's controls were so lax ‌that outsiders, including foreign governments, could obtain sensitive information about the AI lab's technology with relative ease, the people said. For example, anybody at OpenAI who could access its code could see the technical details underlying many company projects.
